prompt.text:
Implement `public static List<String> transformCatalog(List<String> lines, int batchSize)`. The input is an in-memory pipe-delimited catalog. A nonempty input must begin with exactly `sku|title|section`; every later line must contain exactly three nonempty fields separated by two `|` characters. Trim each data field, convert the title to uppercase with locale-independent rules, and emit the header followed by transformed records in original order. `batchSize` must be positive; it controls internal chunk traversal but must not affect results. An empty input returns an empty unmodifiable list. Null inputs, null lines, a missing or incorrect header, or malformed records throw `IllegalArgumentException`. Do not mutate or retain the input list, and return an unmodifiable independent result. Provide a new implementation in `Solution.java`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
